title: MCP hosts show the model one result channel; hunch_context host-visible cost is structuredContent on Claude Code
observation: Claude Code hands the model only structuredContent (not the content text block) for a tool that returns both, so the host-visible cost of a Hunch tool result is max(content, structuredContent), not their sum, and structuredContent.text cannot be dropped. On main 46414c90, hunch_context('src/mcp/server.ts', budget 1500) = content 6,076 chars, structured 9,764 chars (text 6,051 + delivered 1,099 + supplements 991 + omitted 833 + abstention 274): metadata adds ~60% over budget. On the published build installed here (pre-#419) the structured result carried the full per-record omitted list (~20k chars). Separately, ~450 of the 1,500 brief tokens were low-value for a code edit: a project-dna supplement (commit-title punctuation conventions) and recent-task lines titled 'Assistant task'. The footprint gate measured target 'src' on an empty store, which under-reports a real file target.
